title: Three Temple studies verification
author: Pat Robinson
browser_checks: All three production models render and the Explorer links to the comparison collection
Opening interiors, isolation, camera focus, top view, reset, labels and measurements work
Direct canvas selection opens the corresponding component panel
Separation reaches its endpoints by keyboard and button; separation intentionally returns to the whole model and closes the cutaway
The copied URL matches the visible selection, separation, isolation, cutaway and reading lens; reload restores the same settings
The cherubim connection opens 1 Kings 8; the chapter returns to the ark with its sources selected
Source notes open in a modal and Escape dismisses it
All eighteen guided moments were exercised through manual progression
Ezekiel's timed journey ran to 01:30 and offered replay
Reduced-motion mode exposes six manual story moments and immediate transitions
Light and dark themes preserve the selected study and view
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts visually inspected; no horizontal page overflow on measured 360px, 390px, 768px and 1280px widths
Final production browser console contains no captured warnings or errors
limits: The buildings are selective textual reconstructions; undocumented dimensions and source differences are explained in the studies
Ezekiel is presented as a vision; its exterior river distances are compressed
The studies fit their own viewports and do not share a displayed scale or surveyed geographical alignment
Only Ezekiel's full elapsed-time playback was watched; all three sets of manual moments and the shared timer implementation were checked
Physical-device multitouch, forced GPU failure and an independent accessibility audit were not performed
WebGL fallback and hidden-tab lifecycle were reviewed in code
No recorded narration, film export or Blender deliverable was produced
Local preview and commit only; no push, deployment or paid generation
